publisher.name: Red Hill Community Market (Craft Markets Australia)

note: The operator page title reads "Red Hill Community Market(R) - The Red Hill Community Market(R) is temporarily closed." and the body states "The Red Hill Community Market(R) is temporarily closed and not running until a new location is found", that the market is "no longer running at the Red Hill Recreation Reserve & Showgrounds", that it ran "from September to May from 1975 to 2024", and that "Both Red Hill Community Market(R) and Red Hill Market(R) are trademarked and owned by Craft Markets Australia." The page presents itself as a "History Archive". Read first hand on 2026-09-14. This is the highest-precedence source for a trading-status claim and it disputes the record on the name, the operator and the ground, all three.
